title: The Halifax Ghost Walk
gap: Exact cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests join a 1 hour and 40 minute walk through Halifax’s historic city streets hearing tales of ghosts, spirits, and local folklore, supported by local history. Tours mostly start at 8:30pm from the Old Town Clock on Citadel Hill and finish at the waterfront by The Maritime Museum of the Atlantic. Some tours start at 6pm or 7:30pm; times can be confirmed by contacting the operator.
